meta.purpose: Advanced Professional Software Academy — 16 individual learning paths, each with beginner, intermediate and advanced levels, practical exercises, industry use cases, projects, assessments and portfolio deliverables.
meta.rule: No skill counts as complete on video-watching alone. Each level closes only when the exercise is submitted and the assessment is cleared at 70% or above, with the artefact filed in the portfolio.
meta.costNote: All tools listed are learnable free or at low cost. Verify current pricing and student eligibility on the official provider page before paying for anything.
